<section id="agent-workflow">
<h1>Agent Workflow</h1>
<p>This landing page mirrors the generated Markdown reference in
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">docs/agent-workflow.md</span></code>.</p>
<p>Use the canonical top-level WikiMason commands for wiki workflows. The
product is filesystem-backed and does not expose a runtime bridge or a
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">obsidian</span></code> command namespace.</p>
<section id="first-run-workflow">
<h2>First-run workflow</h2>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">doctor</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">source</span> <span class="pre">scan</span> <span class="pre">--update</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">source</span> <span class="pre">delta</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">ingest</span> <span class="pre">status</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">ingest</span> <span class="pre">plan</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Draft semantic note bodies only after <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">note</span> <span class="pre">new</span> <span class="pre">...</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">links</span> <span class="pre">check</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">ingest</span> <span class="pre">finish</span> <span class="pre">--accept-covered</span> <span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">json</span></code></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="hard-rules">
<h2>Hard rules</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Do not run upstream <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">obsidian</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">obsidian-cli</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p>Use only the WikiMason CLI commands listed in this reference; do not run upstream starter scripts such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">scripts/wiki_tool.py</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p>Do not hand-edit generated catalog, index, or source-manifest files.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
